indicator_name: Goods exports by HS chapter (2 digits), tonnes, monthly
description: Экспорт товаров по группам (главам) ТН ВЭД ЕАЭС, тонн, помесячно
methodology: National. TOTAL is the published national row; a chapter is the sum of its 6-digit lines over the regional blocks (months whose lines miss the national row keep TOTAL only). HS99 = code 999999 «Прочие товары»; chapter 93 is not published. Tonnes: natural gas (271121) and electricity (2716) are published in additional units only — zero tonnes. Raw file: bns_exports_2026-09-16.xlsx.
